links.outcome: Consistency of repeated GPT-4 responses and its correlation with accuracy on exam questions
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 51.82% to 66.18% with prompt optimization including self-consistency; response consistency was significantly and positively correlated with accuracy.
links.quote: A significant positive correlation was observed between the consistency and accuracy of GPT-4's responses.

unlisted_practices: Chinese-term annotation and English translation of prompts to improve LLM accuracy on Korean medicine questions

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates GPT-4 on a medical licensing examination benchmark and directly tests the impact of prompt engineering techniques (language-related prompting, exam-optimized instruction, self-consistency) on model performance.
